Name: Elishama, the Priest
Summary: Elishama was one of the priests sent with Jehoshaphat's princes and Levites to teach the book of the law throughout Judah.
KeyStory: With the Levites went Elishama and Jehoram, priests, teaching in Judah with the book of the law of the LORD.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.
